div.div:
Supported actions
add_labels · remove_labels · assign · unassign · set_milestone · clear_milestone · add_to_project · close · reopen
Label actions accept open/closed issues; reopen is explicit; other active mutations require open issues.
Close on an already-closed issue is a no-op. Discover taxonomy/people/boards before applying unknown values.
